title: Kaleidoscopic Teaming in Multi Agent Simulations
reasoning: The paper introduces the MASK framework to evaluate AI agents in multi-agent simulations. A core component of this evaluation is a 'Judge Rubric' that scores agents based on whether their actions are 'trustworthy,' 'untrustworthy,' or 'harmful' to society. Furthermore, the qualitative examples used for benchmarking explicitly include 'Ethical Dilemmas' and 'Ethical Compliance' as key performance metrics.
